indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_expr_recognized_at_idx ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (((game_scope ->> 'game_union_id'::text)), recognized_at)
CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_recognition_join_cover ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (recognized_at) INCLUDE (table_id, hand_number)
CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_recognition_window ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (recognized_at)

CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_scope_missing ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (recognized_at) WHERE (NOT (game_scope ?& ARRAY['game_union_id'::text, 'host_club_id'::text, 'tournament_id'::text, 'is_private'::text, 'asset'::text, 'unit_scale'::text]))

CREATE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_unaccepted ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (((game_scope ->> 'game_union_id'::text)), recognized_at) WHERE (((evidence ->> 'status'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready'::text) OR ((evidence -> 'basis_certified'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb) OR ((evidence -> 'all_players_included'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb) OR ((evidence -> 'game_scope'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM game_scope))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_hand_id_key ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (hand_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX union_pnl_cash_outcomes_pkey ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes USING btree (table_id, hand_number)

triggers.name: RI_ConstraintTrigger_OBJECT
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER "RI_ConstraintTrigger_OBJECT" AFTER INSERT ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes FROM union_pnl_transaction_frames NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "RI_FKey_check_ins"()

triggers.name: RI_ConstraintTrigger_OBJECT
triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER "RI_ConstraintTrigger_OBJECT" AFTER UPDATE ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes FROM union_pnl_transaction_frames NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "RI_FKey_check_upd"()

triggers.name: original_pnl_immutable
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER original_pnl_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_union_pnl_inventory_immutable()

triggers.name: union_pnl_cash_outcome_touch
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER union_pnl_cash_outcome_touch AFTER INSERT ON public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_touch()
